summary: applySchemaV4 condition check always true - it checks if columns exist (which they always do from v2+), not if they have NOT NULL constraints
failure_scenario: Every time schema v4 migration runs, it will rebuild the table even if constraints were already removed; or, if migrating from v2/v3 with NOT NULL columns, the migration may fail to run entirely

summary: resolveProxyTarget parses config target URL outside try block; old code had try around entire resolution including config parsing
failure_scenario: If proxyConfig.target is malformed URL, throws uncaught exception before reaching DB fallback logic

summary: "At least one field" validation error doesn't show index in batch validation
failure_scenario: When multiple providers saved and one has all empty optional fields, error points to base_url with no index, making it hard to identify which provider is invalid

summary: Error path logs request.body?.model instead of originalModel
failure_scenario: If provider model replacement is active and request fails, error log will show the replaced model instead of the original one the client sent
